title: Gold Bar Reload Sour Apple Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2 x Pods
description: Gold Bar Reload Sour Apple Prefilled Pods deliver a tart, zesty vape with the bold flavour of crisp Green Apple. Balancing sourness with a touch of natural sweetness, this pod offers a vibrant fruit profile that’s both punchy and satisfying. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with the Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit. Fitted with mesh coil technology, these pods deliver consistent vapour and rich flavour with every draw. The prefilled design ensures simple, mess-free use—just insert and inhale. Whether you're looking for a reliable daily vape or something sharp and refreshing, Sour Apple is a great choice for those who enjoy fruit flavours with a tangy edge.
